title: Jack Carey advertising on the wagon and the Creole with the gun
summary: Vincent tells how Jack Carey's band advertised dances from a wagon, a gun-carrying Creole stopped them, and he rode along as a boy of 13 or 14.

story.theme_name: Brass bands, parades and jazz funerals
story.community_name: Parading for Mardi Gras and the clubs
